title: Kitne Aadmi The
description: Gabbar Singh's chilling interrogation of his defeated henchmen in Sholay (1975). The gravelly 'Kitne aadmi the?' became one of the most quoted lines in Indian cinema history.
clip_note: Full Gabbar-Kaalia scene. The 'Kitne aadmi the?' line lands around 6:00–7:00. Confirm exact second after viewing. Alternate search: YouTube 'Kitne Aadmi The Most Famous Dialogue Sholay Gabbar Singh Amazon Prime Video'.

title: Tera Kya Hoga Kaliya
description: Gabbar Singh's sadistic taunting of his henchman Kaalia before the iconic Russian-roulette scene in Sholay (1975). Dark humour at its most chilling.
clip_note: Same scene as snd-01 but clip focuses on 'Ab tera kya hoga, Kaaliya?' line. The revolver scene follows immediately. Timestamp approx 6:20–7:10.

title: Flower Nahi Fire Hai
description: Pushpa Raj's defiant self-introduction in Pushpa: The Rise (2021). 'Pushpa naam sunke flower samjhe kya? Flower nahi, fire hai main!' instantly became a pan-India meme.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Pushpa Flower Nahi Fire Hai Allu Arjun official dialogue' on the Lahari Music or AA Films channel. The short clip is ~15–20 seconds.

title: Jhukega Nahi Saala
description: Pushpa Raj's signature defiance cry from Pushpa: The Rise (2021) — 'Pushpa Raj mein jhukega nahi sala!' Used universally to express that you won't back down.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Jhunega Nahi Sala Pushpa Raj'. Multiple fan and official short clips available. The audio is ~5–10 seconds.

title: Fire Nahi Wildfire Hai
description: The upgraded version from Pushpa 2: The Rule (2024) — 'Fire nahi, wildfire hun!' Allu Arjun's delivery sent theatres into a frenzy across India.
clip_note: Released December 2024. Search YouTube for 'Pushpa 2 wildfire dialogue'. Official Mythri Movie Makers channel likely has the clip.

title: Mogambo Khush Hua
description: Amrish Puri's iconic declaration of villainous pleasure in Mr. India (1987). 'Mogambo khush hua!' is used as the ultimate sarcastic approval reaction in Indian meme culture.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Mogambo Khush Hua Mr India'. The line appears multiple times in the film. Many official short clips on Shemaroo Bollywood channel.

title: Mere Paas Maa Hai
description: Shashi Kapoor's understated reply to Amitabh Bachchan's list of riches in Deewar (1975). 'Mere paas maa hai' is perhaps the most emotionally resonant five-word sentence in Bollywood.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Mere Paas Maa Hai Deewar 1975'. Dailymotion also hosts this clip. The exchange is about 60 seconds long.

title: Aaj Khush Toh Bahut Hoge Tum
description: Amitabh Bachchan's sardonic line to God in Deewar (1975) — 'Aaj khush toh bahut hoge tum.' Widely used as a sarcastic reaction when someone's plan backfires.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Aaj khush toh bahut hoge tum Deewar scene'. Vijay's temple scene; line comes near end of the film.

title: Bade Bade Deshon Mein
description: Shah Rukh Khan's smooth excuse in DDLJ (1995) — 'Bade bade deshon mein aisi choti choti baatein hoti rehti hain, Senorita.' Indians use it to brush off any minor screw-up with maximum style.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'DDLJ Bade Bade Deshon mein'. Yash Raj Films official channel posts scene clips from DDLJ periodically. The line is ~10 seconds.

title: Ja Simran Ja
description: Amrish Puri's tearful blessing in DDLJ (1995) — 'Ja Simran ja, jee le apni zindagi.' The iconic train-platform farewell that defined an era of Bollywood romance.
clip_note: Search Yash Raj Films YouTube channel. The train-platform scene is the film's climax. Audio clip is ~8 seconds. YRF regularly re-uploads anniversary clips.

title: Aal Izz Well
description: Rancho's calming mantra from 3 Idiots (2009) — 'Aal izz well!' Originally a trick to fool the heart, it became India's most optimistic WhatsApp forward and ringtone.
clip_note: Search YouTube for '3 Idiots All Izz Well scene'. The 'heart-fooling' explanation scene is early in the film. Multiple official and fan uploads available.

title: Life Is a Race
description: Virus's pressure-cooker speech from 3 Idiots (2009) — 'Life is a race. Agar tez nahi bhaage toh koi tujhe kuchal ke aage nikal jaayega!' The definitive Indian parent/teacher meme.
clip_note: Search YouTube 'Virus Entry Life is a Race 3 Idiots Boman Irani'. Ultra Bollywood Facebook page has an official clip. ~30-second audio needed.

title: Teja Main Hu Mark Idhar Hai
description: Paresh Rawal's absurd self-correction in Andaz Apna Apna (1994) — 'Teja main hu, Mark idhar hai!' A perfectly timed comedy gem that became a benchmark for confused-character memes.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Teja main hu Andaz Apna Apna'. Film is available on Amazon Prime Video. Many fan-cut clips exist; ~10–15 seconds of audio needed.

title: Crime Master Gogo Naam Hai Mera
description: Shakti Kapoor's gloriously absurd villain introduction in Andaz Apna Apna (1994) — 'Crime Master Gogo naam hai mera, aankhen nikaal ke gotiyan khelta hoon main!'
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Crime Master Gogo Andaz Apna Apna'. The introduction scene. ~20-second clip needed.

title: Tumse Na Ho Payega
description: Ramadhir Singh's withering dismissal of his son in Gangs of Wasseypur 2 (2012) — 'Beta, tumse na ho payega.' Improvised by Tigmanshu Dhulia on set; became the go-to Indian 'you can't do it' meme.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Tumse na ho payega Gangs of Wasseypur 2'. Tigmanshu Dhulia delivers the line as Ramadhir Singh. ~10-second clip.

title: Keh Ke Lunga
description: Sardar Khan's oath of revenge in Gangs of Wasseypur (2012) — 'Teri keh ke lunga!' Manoj Bajpayee's delivery is electrifying; the phrase is used when promising a spectacular comeback.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Teri Keh Ke Lunga Gangs of Wasseypur'. The song version and the spoken dialogue scene are both available. The spoken version is the meme source (~5 sec).

title: Bhai Kya Kar Raha Hai Tu
description: Ashneer Grover's exasperated reaction on Shark Tank India Season 1 (2022) to a pitcher selling glass-rim covers — 'Bhai, kya kar raha hai tu?' Instantly meme-fied across every Indian platform.
clip_note: Episode aired Jan 26, 2022. Search Sony LIV or SET India YouTube channel for 'Shark Tank India Ashneer Grover Sippline Bhai kya kar raha hai'. Clip is ~15 seconds.

title: Thappad Se Darr Nahi Lagta
description: Sonakshi Sinha's feisty one-liner in Dabangg (2010) — 'Thappad se darr nahi lagta sahab, pyaar se lagta hai.' One of the most remixed and quoted Bollywood feminist one-liners.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Thappad se darr nahi lagta Dabangg scene'. Spoken by Sonakshi Sinha's character Rajjo to Salman Khan (Chulbul Pandey). ~8-second clip.

title: Swagat Nahi Karoge Hamara
description: Salman Khan's self-assured entry line in Dabangg 2 (2012) — 'Swagat nahi karoge aap hamara?' Chulbul Pandey's swagger in audio form; used at every grand entrance.
clip_note: Search Eros Now YouTube channel for 'Dabangg 2 Swagat nahi karoge'. Eros Now posted anniversary clips. The line is ~5 seconds.

title: Ek Baar Jo Maine Commitment
description: Salman Khan's unbreakable-promise declaration in Wanted (2009) — 'Ek baar jo maine commitment kar di, uske baad toh main khud ki bhi nahi sunta.' The definitive I-won't-back-down brag.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Ek baar jo maine commitment kar di Wanted'. Popular clip; ~12 seconds of audio. Multiple upload versions exist.

title: Ye Baburao Ka Style Hai
description: Paresh Rawal's Babu Rao claiming ownership of his chaotic methods in Hera Pheri (2000) — 'Ye Baburao ka style hai!' A timeless meme for doing things your own absurd way.
clip_note: Search Amazon Prime Video India or Prime Video YouTube for 'Ye Baburao Ka Style Hai Best of Babu Bhaiya'. Amazon Prime posted an official 8-min compilation. Clip needed ~5 seconds.

title: Utha Le Re Baba
description: Babu Rao's dramatic plea to God in Hera Pheri (2000) — 'Utha le re baba, utha le! Mereko nahi, inn dono ko utha le!' The definitive 'I'm done with everything' meme sound.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Utha le re baba Hera Pheri'. Multiple fan clips and meme template sites reference the source scene. ~10-second audio.

title: Mera Swabhav Hi Mera Parichay
description: Rocky Bhai's defining self-declaration in KGF: Chapter 1 (2018, Hindi dub) — 'Mera swabhav hi mera parichay hai.' Yash's baritone made this the ultimate mass-hero attitude line.
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'KGF Chapter 1 Rocky dialogue mera swabhav'. Hindi dubbed version. Hombale Films YouTube channel has official Hindi promo clips. ~10-second clip.

title: Sahi Pakde Hain
description: Angoori Bhabhi's signature catchphrase from the TV show Bhabhi Ji Ghar Par Hain — 'Sahi pakde hain!' Used by Indians online to confirm a correct guess or observation with theatrical flair.
clip_note: Search AND TV official YouTube channel for 'Bhabhi Ji Ghar Par Hain Sahi pakde hain'. Phrase appears hundreds of times across episodes. Find a clean, short delivery (~3-5 seconds).

title: Pushpa Naam Sunke Flower Samjhe Kya
description: The full iconic monologue from Pushpa: The Rise (2021) where Allu Arjun corrects everyone who underestimates him: 'Pushpa naam sunke flower samjha kya? Flower nahi, fire hai main. Jhukunga nahi.'
clip_note: Search YouTube for 'Pushpa naam sunke flower samjhe kya full dialogue'. The complete monologue is ~25 seconds. Available as a #shorts clip on Lahari Music or AA Films channel.
